_comment: Explicit redirect targets for profiles DELIBERATELY removed from the vault (not renamed, not purged as a phantom twin — genuinely removed because the evidence did not support them). The emit-git-slug-redirects.mjs guard matches a vanished live URL to a successor by display_name / vault_file / tagset / namekey. A removed person has NO successor by any of those keys, so without this file the guard correctly refuses to emit a partial redirect set and the regen fails closed. Add an entry here ONLY with a reason and a date, and only after the removal is recorded in the vault's Corrections Log.

<old-slug>.to: <slug of the page a visitor should land on, or null for a soft 410-style notice>
<old-slug>.corrections_log: the Corrections Log heading that records this removal

esther-naomi-lynette-telfer-1983.reason: Date correction, not a removal. The page was titled (b. 1983) from a bad OCR read of '6 Mar 1983' in the 2008 Supplement's scan-derived text layer. Two independent sources print 1993: the 1989 book's text layer ('b. 6 Mar 1993 Tumby Bay, SA') and a direct reading of the Supplement's printed page 145. The Supplement scan's OCR layer misread the 9 as an 8. Page retitled to 1993.
esther-naomi-lynette-telfer-1983.corrections_log: 2026-10-25 — CORRECTION: Esther Naomi Lynette Telfer birth year 1983 → 1993 (OCR misread, two sources agree)

ann-taylor-1856.reason: Fabricated spouse. No 'Ann Taylor' exists in any of the three gold books; her stated husband 'John Telfer (1847-1923)' does not exist either (all three books give 1847-1929 and print his marriage to Caroline Amelia Masters six times in the Supplement alone). Her nine children have no book support. Visitors land on the man her stub was wrongly attached to.
ann-taylor-1856.corrections_log: 2026-09-22 — REMOVED: "Ann Taylor (~1856–?)" and four fabricated children (books contradict the vault)

ann-telfer.reason: Fabricated child of the Ann Taylor stub. No standalone daughter named Ann in this family — every 'Ann Telfer' in the books is a MIDDLE name (Susan Ann, Mary Ann, Sarah Ann, Sandra Ann). Empty 212-byte shell with no dates.
ann-telfer.corrections_log: 2026-09-22 — REMOVED: "Ann Taylor (~1856–?)" and four fabricated children (books contradict the vault)

Jonathon Scot TELFER, b. 31 Jan 1995'; Mark Telfer confirmed the family spelling as 'Scott' (2 t's) on 2026-10-25. The page is now named for the printed person and 'Jono' is recorded as an alias. This is a rename, not a removal — the person and their record are unchanged.
jono-telfer.corrections_log: 2026-10-25 — RENAMED: 'Jono Telfer' → "Jonathon Scott Telfer (b. 1995)" (nickname in page title)

kristin-stefanoff.reason: Page title carried only the married surname and no middle name or dates. A Telfer Family Tree (2008), printed p.144 records '1. Kristin Holly TELFER, b. 26 Mar 1985 Tumby Bay, SA'; she married Ben Stefanoff. The page is now titled 'Kristin Holly (Telfer) Stefanoff (b. 1985)' so that the maiden name, middle name and birth year all resolve. This is a rename, not a removal.

beryl-ruth-telfer-1949.reason: Phantom duplicate, not a real person. 'Beryl Ruth Telfer' was produced by OCR corruption of 'Miriam Ruth Telfer, b. 5 Jul 1949' in the 2008 Supplement's scan-derived text layer. Two independent sources print Miriam Ruth: the Supplement's own Reginald/Edwin block and the Borders text layer. Miriam Ruth already has her own profile (miriam-ruth-telfer-1949), correctly parented to Edwin Roy Telfer. The phantom carried a wrong father link that was ALSO poisoning Brenda Janice and Lyndell Marie's parentage. Visitors land on the real person.
beryl-ruth-telfer-1949.corrections_log: 2026-10-26 — REMOVED: "Beryl Ruth Telfer (1949)" phantom (OCR corruption of Miriam Ruth Telfer)

stanley-lawrence-pedler-1948.reason: Phantom, not a person. Created from the 2008 Supplement OCR line 'stan Laweonce PEDLER, b. 20 Dec 1948', which is 'Allan Lawrence PEDLER, b. 20 Dec 1946'. Gladys own chapter in From the Borders to the Bush names four children (Stanley James, Mary Ellen, Shirley Irene, Allan Lawrence) and states 'On 20th December, 1946, our next baby boy, Allan Lawrence, was born.'
stanley-lawrence-pedler-1948.corrections_log: 2026-10-26 REMOVED: Stanley Lawrence Pedler (1948) phantom child of Gladys Merle Telfer (OCR artifact of Allan Lawrence Pedler, b. 1946)
